en.headline: Pingu Christmas ice village opens at Tsim Sha Tsui LCX today
en.dek: The free NOOT NOOT festive installation runs until 3 January at Harbour City's Ocean Terminal third floor, with five photo spots and a limited shop.
body: A Christmas-themed installation featuring the claymation character Pingu opens today at LCX in Tsim Sha Tsui. Organisers said the NOOT NOOT Christmas Ice Fun Village will run from 19 November to 3 January at the third floor of Harbour City's Ocean Terminal.

The free installation includes five interactive photo spots: a Pingu ice slide, a gift exchange station with Pingu and Pinga, a living-room scene, a photo booth, and a polar fishing game. A limited shop nearby will sell nearly 100 themed items, including Hong Kong exclusive blind boxes.

Meet-and-greet sessions with Pingu are scheduled on selected dates including 21 and 28 November and 12, 25 and 26 December, with three sessions each day at the LCX main entrance. Visitors can also collect stamps for a limited photo frame.
The event is open daily from 10am to 10pm. LCX said the collaboration is with Mattel.

zh.headline: Pingu聖誕冰FUN小鎮今日登陸尖沙咀LCX
zh.dek: 免費NOOT NOOT節慶裝置於海港城海運大廈三階展出至1月3日，設五大打卡位及限定店。
body: 以黏土動畫角色Pingu為主題的聖誕裝置今日於尖沙咀LCX開幕。主辦方表示，「NOOT NOOT 聖誕冰FUN小鎮」由11月19日起至明年1月3日於海港城海運大廈三階舉行。
免費裝置設有五大互動打卡位，包括Pingu冰雪滑梯、Pingu與Pinga禮物交換站、溫馨客廳場景、自拍亭，以及極地釣魚遊戲。附近限定店售賣近百款主題精品，包括香港限定盲盒。
Pingu見面會安排於11月21日、28日及12月12日、25日、26日等指定日子，每日三場，地點在LCX正門。訪客亦可集章換領限定相框。
活動每日上午10時至晚上10時開放。LCX指是次合作對象為美泰兒。
